projects.name: Mikyaj Kuwait
projects.headline: Mikyaj Kuwait — Beauty & Skincare Storefront
projects.description: An online makeup and skincare storefront for Mikyaj Kuwait, owned by Saifuddin Garkiya, with product discovery, brand browsing and mobile shopping pages.
projects.overview: Evolix developed the Mikyaj Kuwait website for Saifuddin Garkiya’s beauty business. The public storefront presents makeup and skincare products with category and brand navigation.
projects.visibleFeatures: The public site includes a shopping catalogue, brand browsing, product search and English/Arabic navigation. The screenshots document its desktop and mobile storefront presentation.
projects.availability: The web storefront is available at mikyajkw.com, with public product browsing and shopping pages.
projects.draftReview: We wanted a clear online shopping experience for our makeup and skincare range. Evolix brought the website, catalogue and mobile presentation together around our business.

projects.name: Rashidi Star
projects.headline: Rashidi Star — Garments Business ERP
projects.description: A custom ERP built for Yusuf Ali Jath Wala’s garment business in Kuwait, with a dashboard for shop operations and sales invoicing.
projects.overview: Evolix built Rashidi Star ERP for Yusuf Ali Jath Wala’s garments business in Kuwait. The workspace brings invoicing, stock, purchases, payments and expenses into one place.
projects.visibleFeatures: The dashboard puts frequent actions in reach, including creating an invoice, receiving stock, recording payments and checking inventory. Sales and Invoices gives the team a place to search invoices and filter by payment status.
projects.availability: The project link opens the owner sign-in page. The two screenshots below show the dashboard and sales workflow with financial figures, invoice rows and identifying details removed.
projects.draftReview: Our garments business needed software built around the way we work in Kuwait. Evolix developed a dedicated ERP for Rashidi Star, giving us a single place to manage our business processes.

projects.name: AltivonGlobal
projects.headline: AltivonGlobal — Botanical Ingredients & Exports
projects.description: A botanical ingredients and export website for Nirmit Shah’s Vadodara-based business, presenting products, quality information and buyer enquiry paths.
projects.overview: Evolix developed AltivonGlobal’s website for Nirmit Shah in Vadodara, Gujarat. It introduces the business and its botanical ingredient range to prospective buyers.
projects.visibleFeatures: Public pages present moringa, beetroot and ashwagandha powders, with product, quality, export and quotation navigation. The gallery records the actual public website on desktop and mobile.
projects.availability: The website is available at altivonglobal.com, with product information, export planning pages and a buyer enquiry route.
projects.draftReview: We wanted AltivonGlobal’s website to explain our botanical products and help business buyers make enquiries. Evolix connected the product information, export presentation and enquiry journey in one website.

projects.name: Najmi Hardware
projects.headline: Najmi Hardware — Rope Manufacturing & Supply
projects.description: A rope manufacturing and selling website for Najmuddin Kapasan’s Kuwait business, with product browsing and retail, wholesale and quotation pathways.
projects.overview: Evolix developed Najmi Hardware’s website for Najmuddin Kapasan’s rope manufacturing and selling business in Kuwait. The site gives customers a public destination to explore the range and contact the business.
projects.visibleFeatures: Public navigation includes rope products, STAR ROPE, manufacturing, wholesale, product selection and bulk quotation. The screenshots show the live desktop and mobile website.
projects.availability: The website is available at najmihardware.com, where visitors can explore the rope range and contact the business about their requirements.
projects.draftReview: We needed a website that could present our rope products clearly to customers in Kuwait. Evolix created a place to explore our range and contact us about retail and bulk requirements.

projects.name: Apna Galla
projects.headline: Apna Galla — Retail Shop ERP
projects.description: Evolix’s retail shop ERP brings billing, stock, khata and shop workflows together. Its connected Apna Mart product extends a retailer’s presence online; mobile app development is planned.
projects.overview: Apna Galla is an Evolix product for retail shops. Its public website introduces billing, inventory, khata, purchases, expenses and everyday shop management workflows.
projects.visibleFeatures: The public site includes feature information and a browser-based sample-shop demonstration. The screenshots show the product website, not a retailer’s private account or financial records.
projects.availability: The web product is available at apnagalla.in. The owner has described a mobile app as upcoming. Retailers using Apna Galla can connect their shop with Apna Mart for customer ordering; the two products are presented separately here.

projects.name: Apna Mart
projects.headline: Apna Mart — Connected Local Commerce
projects.description: An Evolix product connected with Apna Galla, enabling participating retail shops to go online and customers to order from them. A Play Store app release is planned.
projects.overview: Apna Mart is Evolix’s customer-facing retail product connected with Apna Galla. The owner describes a flow in which a shop using Apna Galla can go live on Apna Mart and receive customer orders.
projects.visibleFeatures: The public web preview introduces nearby shops and customer ordering. At capture time it reported no active service areas, so no shop listings or customer orders were shown. The gallery records this actual public state after the hosting service finished waking up.
projects.availability: The public preview is reachable at apna-mart.in, with service-area activation still pending at capture time. The owner has described the Play Store app as upcoming; this page does not present it as an already released Android app.
